infoLinks.urlText: Glenfield Station Lift 2 between the concourse and Platform 3/4 is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Glenfield Station Lift 2 between the concourse and Platform 3/4 is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 23 until Sunday 29 November, the lift between the concourse and Platforms 3 and 4 will be closed for lift maintenance.

Customers on the concourse that need lift access to Platform 3 or 4 will need to catch a train from Platform 1 or 2 and change at Holsworthy or Liverpool Station to continue their journey.

Customers arriving on Platform 3 or 4 that need lift access to the concourse will need to catch a train to Edmondson Park or Macquarie Fields Station and return via Platform 1 or 2.

Baggage handlers will be available to assist during busy times.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9765 1162.
